cohort: 96 pregnant women with meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) and their neonates were included from Darbhanga Medical College and Hospital.
finding: Advanced maternal age, nulliparity, post-term pregnancy, and pregnancy-induced hypertension were significant risk factors for MSAF, and neonates born with MSAF had lower Apgar scores at 1 minute, higher incidences of respiratory distress, and were more likely to be admitted to the NICU.
birth_weight: measured, but no significant difference found between neonates with and without MSAF
